mapper.insert: INSERT INTO script_marketing_task (tenant_id, created_by, task_name, steps_json, status, interval_seconds, start_at, end_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{createdBy}, #{taskName}, #{stepsJson}, #{status}, #{intervalSeconds}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM script_marketing_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE script_marketing_task SET task_name=#{taskName}, steps_json=#{stepsJson}, interval_seconds=#{intervalSeconds}, start_at=#{startAt}, end_at=#{endAt}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status=0
UPDATE script_marketing_task SET status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: t.id, t.task_name, t.status, t.interval_seconds, t.start_at, t.end_at, t.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM script_marketing_group g WHERE g.task_id=t.id) AS group_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM script_marketing_send_record r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.status=2) AS success_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM script_marketing_send_record r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.status=3) AS failed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM script_marketing_send_record r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.status=4) AS unknown_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM script_marketing_send_record r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.status=1) AS in_flight_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM script_marketing_task t WHERE ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT FROM script_marketing_task t WHERE t.id=#{id}
